messages:
emma: Quick a11y sweep notes from the dashboard demo w/ NVDA+Firefox and keyboard-only. Kept it short, filing items for triage.

liam: sending — thanks emma. can you call out which pages/screens?

emma: main dashboard (models list + quick actions), streaming logs panel, and the compact metrics cards (dark theme). Highlights:
• streaming toast uses aria-live=polite but fires repeatedly for token-level events; NVDA keeps interrupting the user flow. recommend batching announcements or switching to visually-only for token stream and using a single polite summary for completion.
• chart color palette: small bars in the utilization chart drop to ~2.8:1 on dark — fails AA for small data markers.
• mobile hamburger menu: when opened with keyboard, focus lands on first link but Escape closes menu and focus doesn't return to the hamburger button (focus loss).
• role="button" used on divs in quick-action grid; some of these are not keyboard-focusable (no tabindex) so VoiceOver/chromevox skips them.
• metric cards expose decorative SVGs without aria-hidden=true so SR reads duplicate text like "circle".

rachel: oof on the live region flooding. we use it for streaming events to show progress; maybe switch to aria-hidden on the streaming tokens and add a single announcer element that updates every 2s with a summary?

emma: yup. pattern: keep visual streaming, but keep SR updates minimal. summary example: "Streaming complete. 42 tokens generated." Announcer should be role="status" and updated only on key milestones.

dev_alex: on the hamburger/focus restore, I think it's missing the button.focus() call in the menu close handler. I'll audit the Menu.tsx. Also will add keyboard e2e to assert focus returns.

liam: charts 999we probably need alternate palette or outline strokes for small bars. can we compute contrast per-mark?

emma: I used axe-core and a color contrast script — for small bars we should ensure contrast >= 4.5:1 or add a 1px stroke of high-contrast color. rachel: any design preference?

ux_tara: designer input: adding a subtle 1px border using token `--chart-mark-contrast` is fine. prefer not to darken the fill because it shifts the visual weighting. i'll update the tokens and push a tiny figma change.

rachel: SVG accessibility: mark decorative svgs with aria-hidden="true" and role="img" + aria-hidden for icons that have visible text nearby. For complex charts we should provide a summary via <figcaption> or aria-describedby.

emma: also found one nit: quick-action tiles use onClick on divs and custom keyboard handlers but no visible focus style. they need semantic buttons or tabindex+focus-visible. Small controls must show focus for keyboard users.

dev_alex: i'll convert quick-action divs to <button class="tile"> to keep behavior consistent. won't need extra tabindex.

a11y-bot: Automated scan summary: 8 issues found. Severity: 2 high (live-region flooding, focus restoration), 3 medium (chart contrast, interactive semantics), 3 low (decorative svg announcements, missing figcaption, non-specific aria labels). Full report: /internal/a11y/reports/1887654321

liam: prioritization? I'd say live-region + focus restore P0. charts + semantics P1. figcaption + svg P2.

ux_tara: agree. live-region affects screen reader usability during streaming demos. focus restore is also high impact.

emma: small implementation hints for PRs:
- Streaming: remove per-token SR updates. Add a single role="status" announcer updated on complete and errors. Example: `announcer.textContent = `Generation complete: ${tokenCount} tokens`;`
- Menu: ensure close handler calls `triggerButton.focus()` and tests cover Esc and Tab flows.
- Charts: add `stroke: var(--chart-mark-contrast)` for marks < 6px wide OR pick alternate token that meets 4.5:1 for small marks.
- Icons: set `aria-hidden="true"` on decorative svgs and use aria-describedby for charts with a short summary element.

rachel: copy tweak: change toast headline from "New token" to "Streaming token update"? maybe too verbose. open to suggestions.

emma: keep to short: "Streaming update" for SR and visual can show token count. The SR message should be the summary only.

dev_alex: i'll send two PRs: 1) menu + focus tests + semantic button refactor 2) live region change + e2e covering streaming scenario. linking by EOD.

liam: thanks. tagging @ux_tara for token changes so visuals match.

ux_tara: will update Figma tokens for chart stroke and push the modified copy for the toast.

a11y-bot: Re-run recommended after PR merges. Please attach test IDs for e2e so bot can pick them up.

emma: i'll re-test with NVDA after merges and post a 1-line verification here. thanks team :sparkles:
